title: How Evidence Changed a Public Recommendation · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少180词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write an evidence-based reflection of at least 180 words about a decision you changed after receiving new information. Explain the initial belief, the new evidence, one limitation in that evidence, and what further information could change your view again. Use past tenses and at least one relative clause. Use an original situation rather than retelling the water-meter pilot.
Write at least 180 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
